title: 'susi tasks add' infers the acceptance test skeleton
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. From a task title and crate, propose the acceptance command and a named test stub location so agents do not hand-write conventions. Tests zc_task_scaffold_*.
